item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Dense fog returns to some interior valley areas overnight
item.description: High clouds will increase during the overnight hours, and dense fog will return to some interior valley locations tomorrow morning. The next few days will bring a slight increase in high clouds along with continued minor cooling.

item.title: Super Bowl 60: What to know about big game at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara
item.description: The Super Bowl is making its return to Levi's Stadium after 10 years. Here's everything you need to know about the big game.

item.title: Korean grocer H Mart to open its largest US location in the Bay Area
item.description: In addition to fresh produce and Korean cooking staples, this H Mart will also have a food hall with plans for a bar and a mix of casual and sit-down restaurants.

item.title: California Republicans appeal Prop 50 lawsuit to US Supreme Court
item.description: The California Republican Party has filed an emergency application with the U.S. Supreme Court, hoping to block the state from using newly approved congressional district maps in this year's elections.

item.title: Newsom slams world leaders for 'rolling over' to Trump: 'Stop being complicit'
item.description: Newsom slammed European leaders for not being tougher on Trump. "Stop being complicit. It's time to stand tall and firm, have a backbone."

item.title: 1 killed, 1 injured in car crash on San Mateo Bridge, CHP says; westbound lanes reopen
item.description: All westbound lanes of the San Mateo Bridge are reopen following a car crash that killed one person, and injured another, shutting down westbound lanes for hours.

item.title: Air Force One returns to Washington area due to minor electrical issue: White House
item.description: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said the decision to return was made after takeoff when the crew aboard Air Force One identified "a minor electrical issue."

item.title: Hundreds march through SF protesting Trump's 1st year in office, administration's action
item.description: Bay Area residents are joining in on a national call to action. "Free America Walkout" is underway on the anniversary of Pres. Trump's second inauguration.

item.title: Sunnyvale apartment complex damaged; residents displaced following 2-alarm fire, authorities say
item.description: A two-alarm fire in Sunnyvale damaged multiple units of an apartment complex late Tuesday morning. Twenty four people are now displaced.

item.title: One year into Trump's term, California's legal battles pile up
item.description: Attorney General Rob Bonta marked the milestone Tuesday in San Francisco, pointing to early court wins while acknowledging that many of the state's biggest legal fights remain unresolved.
